name: Per-project
whatItIs: A pre-scoped project organized into a focused sprint. Deliverables, timeline, and "done" are defined up front.
howItWorks: We scope it together, then I organize the deliverables into a series of two-week sprints. You get finished assets without managing the day-to-day.
bestFor: When you need a batch of assets fast, like after a positioning refresh when your deck, datasheets, and website copy all need to catch up.
